docRequirement: `agent-sdk/hooks.md` line 181 lists `DirectoryAdded` as a hook event (Python SDK: No, TypeScript SDK: Yes) that fires when "A working directory is added during a session", with the example "Install dependencies for a repository added mid-session". The main `hooks.md` reference now specifies it fully (re-fetched 2026-08-02, 13 hits, section `### DirectoryAdded` at line 2462): it "Runs after a working directory is added mid-session, with the `/add-dir` command or the SDK `register_repo_root` control request", does NOT fire for the `--add-dir` startup flag (that is `SessionStart`), fires after sandbox and permission state have been refreshed, supports a matcher on how the directory was added with the two values `slash_command` and `register_repo_root`, and its input carries `directory` (absolute path added) and `source` in addition to the common fields. It has no decision control. Output handling is source-dependent: for `slash_command` the hook's `systemMessage` is delivered to Claude as context on the next turn (unique to this event) and stderr/failures go to the debug log; for `register_repo_root` both go to the debug log only.
current: `DirectoryAdded` exists nowhere in our source: `grep -ran DirectoryAdded packages apps` -> 0 hits (`-a`, so NUL-byte files are covered; the only repo hits are this sweep's own docs). It is absent from all five gates a hook event must pass. (1) The plugin-facing union `PluginHookEventName` carries 30 names and not this one — `packages/shared/src/plugins/hooks-runtime.ts:25-55`; its doc comment at `:12-19` says "hooks.md enumerates 30 events; we emit 28 of them" and accounts for exactly two deliberate deferrals (`MessageDisplay`, `TeammateIdle`). (2) `CLAUDE_HOOK_EVENT_MAP` has 28 entries and no `DirectoryAdded` — `packages/shared/src/plugins/format-adapters.ts:123-152`, under the comment "28 of the 30 documented Claude hook events" at `:117-122`. (3) `DEFERRED_EXTERNAL_HOOK_EVENT_REASONS` holds exactly `MessageDisplay` and `TeammateIdle` — `format-adapters.ts:99-102`. (4) The automations contract inventory `AGENT_EVENT_CONTRACTS_V1` has rows for `CwdChanged` (`packages/shared/src/automations/types.ts:72`) and `FileChanged` (`:73`) but none for `DirectoryAdded`; `AgentEvent` is derived from that array at `:105` and `AGENT_EVENTS` at `:114`. (5) The event-bus payload map `EventPayloadMap` lists `CwdChanged`/`FileChanged` at `packages/shared/src/automations/event-bus.ts:106-107`, no `DirectoryAdded`. Consequence at the import boundary: `mapExternalHookEventName` resolves dialect table -> deferral table -> warning with NO generic fallback (`format-adapters.ts:622-646`), so a Claude plugin declaring `DirectoryAdded` produces the `warning`-severity diagnostic `plugin.format.unknown_hook_event` ("External hook event \"DirectoryAdded\" is not mapped for claude compatibility.") and `format-adapters/claude.ts:1308-1319` files the generic `plugin.deferred.claude_hook_event_unsupported` instead of a routed reason code. A user hand-writing the event into a hooks config file is rejected at `packages/shared/src/automations/hooks-config.ts:137` ("DirectoryAdded is not an agent lifecycle hook event"), and a runtime hook registration naming it is dropped at `packages/shared/src/capabilities/runtime-automations.ts:204` (`if (!AGENT_EVENT_SET.has(hook.event)) return null`). No emitter exists: the fork has no `/add-dir` command and no `register_repo_root` control request (`grep -rain 'add-dir|add_dir|register_repo_root'` over `packages`/`apps` source finds only `--add-dir` prose in `packages/shared/src/capabilities/types.ts:197-201` and zero `register_repo_root`). The one real mid-session directory-add path is `case 'addDirectories'` in `packages/shared/src/agent/pi-agent.ts:3193-3212`, reached from a hook's `updatedPermissions` output, which refuses any `destination` other than `'session'` at `:3194-3199` and appends to `sessionAdditionalDirectories` at `:3208-3209`.
divergence: The whole event is missing, not a renamed key: there is no `DirectoryAdded` identifier, no contract row, no matcher projection and no emission point. Two separable deltas. (a) Import classification is wrong for a documented event: the code's own stated rule at `format-adapters.ts:634-635` — "A documented-but-unemitted event is a deferral, not an unknown name" — is not applied here, because the event never made it into `DEFERRED_EXTERNAL_HOOK_EVENT_REASONS`, so the author gets a typo-shaped warning rather than a routed deferral reason. (b) The event itself is unimplemented: no `AGENT_EVENT_CONTRACTS_V1` row, no payload carrying `directory`/`source`, no matcher projection of `source` (so the documented `slash_command`/`register_repo_root` matcher values have nothing to match), and no emit at the only trigger we own. Also stale as a side effect: the counts "30 documented events" (`hooks-runtime.ts:13`), "28 of the 30" (`format-adapters.ts:118`) and the same phrase in the test comment (`format-adapters.test.ts:3690`) were correct against the main reference page and are now wrong — that page enumerates 31 events as of 2026-08-02.

blastRadius: Crosses a persistence boundary and a package boundary. `AGENT_EVENTS` (derived from `AGENT_EVENT_CONTRACTS_V1`) is the accepted-vocabulary set for on-disk automations config: `packages/shared/src/automations/schemas.ts:200` builds the zod enum from it, `packages/shared/src/automations/hooks-config.ts:25,137` validates user/project hooks-config files against it, and `packages/shared/src/capabilities/runtime-automations.ts:32,200,204` gates runtime hook registration on it. Widening it is forward-compatible (old configs still parse) but a config file written with `DirectoryAdded` errors on an older build — that is the release-ordering risk. `AGENT_EVENT_CONTRACTS_V1` is a versioned inventory (`version: 1`) mirrored into the Pi subprocess: the roster is enumerated in `packages/pi-agent-server/src/extensions/lifecycle-bridge.test.ts:16`, `packages/pi-agent-server/src/__tests__/extension-first/behavior-contract.test.ts:19` and the fixture `packages/pi-agent-server/src/__tests__/extension-first/fixtures/behavior-corpus.json`, and it is baked into the built bundles `packages/pi-agent-server/dist/index.js:342375` and `apps/electron/resources/pi-agent-server/index.js:342375`, plus the adapter tables in `apps/electron/dist/main.cjs:362458,362473` — all of which need a rebuild, not just a source edit. Type-enforced fan-out inside `packages/shared`: `PLUGIN_HOOK_EVENT_TO_AGENT_EVENT` (`hooks-automation.ts:372-403`) is `satisfies Record<PluginHookEventName, AgentEvent | null>` and will fail typecheck until updated; `format-adapters/claude.ts:11` and `hooks-automation.ts:47` import `PluginHookEventName`. Direct test callers: `packages/shared/src/plugins/__tests__/format-adapters.test.ts:3689-3706`, `packages/shared/src/automations/conditions.test.ts:674`, `packages/shared/src/automations/hook-command.test.ts:483`, `packages/shared/src/automations/automation-system.test.ts:638`. Two things it does NOT touch: the renderer's hand-maintained `AGENT_EVENTS` (`apps/electron/src/renderer/components/automations/types.ts:55-59`) is a separate 13-event picker subset that already omits `CwdChanged` and `FileChanged`, so no change is required there for parity with sibling events; and the `AgentEvent` union parsed by `packages/shared/src/agent/__tests__/adjacent-backend-frozen-contract.test.ts:165` is the Pi SDK message-type union, an identically-named symbol in a different subsystem, unaffected.
userImpact: Today, concretely: a user installs a Claude plugin whose `hooks/hooks.json` declares a `DirectoryAdded` hook (the doc's own example is "Install dependencies for a repository added mid-session"). The install succeeds, that hook is dropped from the plugin's capabilities, and the install result carries a warning reading `External hook event "DirectoryAdded" is not mapped for claude compatibility.` — which reads as a typo in the plugin rather than a known Nessy gap, unlike `MessageDisplay`/`TeammateIdle` which import as recorded deferrals. The Sources UI does not render plugin diagnostics today, so inside the desktop app the visible outcome is just a hook silently missing from the plugin's capability list; the wording is visible through the marketplace/install RPC response and the agent-facing plugin-management tool result. A user hand-writing `DirectoryAdded` into a hooks config file gets the load error `<source>: DirectoryAdded is not an agent lifecycle hook event`. Beyond the wording, nothing the plugin author wrote would run even if the name were accepted: the fork has no `/add-dir` command and no `register_repo_root` control request, so the only way a working directory is added mid-session is another hook granting `updatedPermissions.addDirectories` at session scope — a path that fires no event at all. What would make the full gap surface is shipping a user-facing add-directory action; until then, the observable part of this is the misclassified install warning.
